text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Gran 
Alegria—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! Do you have a moment after 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to join you for your special way 
of blowing off some steam, Trainer!
choice_data_list: A special change of pace...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's my personal rule! 'On days you yawn a 
lot, you gotta tag along for someone 
else's special break'!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I want that partner to be you, Trainer! 
Come on, let's have fun anywhere and 
everywhere!
choice_data_list:
Still, maybe it's not really anything 
special...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. ...In that case, how about 
something like this?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We're going to create a new personal rule 
for Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you need a change of pace, do 
this! Having your own rule like that makes 
for the ultimate breather, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...This might be a good opportunity. If I 
have an effective way to refresh myself, I 
might be able to handle my work even more 
efficiently than before."
choice_data_list: Then maybe I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~♪ There's so much strawberry pulp...! 
It's delicious at ninety miles an hour~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Trainer! To think you knew 
about such a wonderful shop!
choice_data_list:
...Still, it really just feels like an 
ordinary day off.

...Still, it just feels like an ordinary 
day off, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, doesn't really feel that special, 
huh~. Let's try checking out somewhere 
else then!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's a great rhythm! Next, barrage with 
your steps...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yay, you cleared it! Splendid job, 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, there is a sense of 
accomplishment in clearing it. However..."
choice_data_list:
If anything, it's the physical exhaustion 
that's getting to me...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so that's not it then~

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet, though! We'll definitely find 
the perfect set of personal rules for you, 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Listening to Diet broadcasts on the radio 
is my personal rule, and I find it super 
relaxing!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has one, after all. Their very 
own code—their personal rule!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. She must have formed her 
own personal rules from her past memories, 
experiences, and unique values."
choice_data_list:
(In that case, the memories and 
experiences unique to me are—)

(In that case, the memories and 
experiences unique to me are—)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"‘The true Mile Queen... Conquer all three 
categories and prove that milers reign 
supreme!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's that place, it might be worthy of 
my rule...!
choice_data_list: I think I found it—my own way to unwind!
I think I found it—my own way to unwind!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah, really?! I wonder what it's like, I 
want to see it soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to Tracen Academy, the one who 
brought Gran Alegria along was—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The training track? ...Hrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Still, isn't this the scenery you always 
see? Does this really help you 
refresh...?"
choice_data_list: Because I saw your potential here.
Because I saw your potential here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before Gran Alegria's debut. That day when 
she showed what she was truly capable of 
against the strongest miler, Taiki 
Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw it clearly: the sight of her 
standing amidst roaring applause as the 
true Queen of the Mile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Excitement, anticipation, emotion—the heat 
of that moment unmistakably belonged to me 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I can just remember that pounding in 
my chest, even a little... —I can overcome 
anything, no matter how tough."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see... This is your special place. A 
personal rule just for you, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: ...Is it a bit weird after all?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it might seem a little unusual, I 
suppose. Since this is a place we visit 
all the time.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: However—it's truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Rules made for no one else, designed for 
me to shine the brightest. That's what my 
"My Rules" are all about!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I might make some new discoveries too! 
All right, time to relax~!"
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll go along with Gran's house 
rules.
Let's look back on that day together!
I really need to thank you.
I have to thank you

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I might make some new discoveries too! 
All right, time to relax~!"
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll go along with Gran's house 
rules.
Let's look back on that day together!
I really need to thank you.
I have to thank you

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer... to me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Protecting your values and making your own 
rules. Having experienced that now, I can 
say it with certainty.
choice_data_list:
I want to learn more about the things you 
hold dear.

I want to know more about what you hold 
dear.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, of course! I'll teach you all of my 
personal rules!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Sounds lovely! That day... I still can't 
forget it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Our new house rule was born 
on that very day, wasn't it!
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course I remember.
Yeah, of course I remember.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! Let's keep making that my-rule 
of yours come true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we reminisced about that day together, 
she smiled like the sun.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? I didn't do anything, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true. If it weren't for her, 
my rules never would have been born. 
...So—"
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you being here.
It's all thanks to you being here

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if that's what's going on! You're 
very welcome!
